acceptance.claim: POST /v1/submit-unclaimed applies TS-UNC where eligible: skipped for PS and Court-stage notices (only RDP/DN update), fails 'Not eligible for suspension' for ineligible stages; then generates Excel with per-notice result
acceptance.missing: Skip list is incomplete: TS-UNC is also skipped (RDP/DN still updated, result success=true) when the notice has no current offender in ONOD and when no letter recipient matches the current offender. For ineligible stages the loop does 'continue', so RDP/DN is NOT updated for those notices.
acceptance.fix_en: POST /v1/submit-unclaimed applies TS-UNC once per eligible notice. TS-UNC is skipped, and only the RDP/DN update is done, for PS notices, Court-stage notices, notices with no current offender in ONOD, and notices where no letter recipient is the current offender. A notice at an ineligible stage is not updated at all and fails with 'Not eligible for suspension'. It then generates an Excel report with the per-notice processing result.
